s: Haqqetannim matay yatchilu lehitannot ubo y"a seipim: kol haddebarim haasurim beyom hakkippurim mishshum mitzvat innuy bilbad — lo gazeru al haqqetannim, lepikak muttar legadol lehaakil et haqqatan ulehashqoto ulesuko ulerochtzo betzonen, abal lo yarchitzennu bechammin kol gupo, apillu huchammu mibbeod yom, sheharechitza bechammin enah asura mishshum mitzvat innuy bilbad, shehare bekol shabbetot hashshana asur lirchotz bechammin, ella yesh bah gam mishshum gezerat merchatz (perush shehabballanim hem chashudim lehachem mayim beshabbat, ulekak aseru liknos lammerchatz beshabbat) kemo shennitbaer besiman shk"v, ulepikak asur laasotah leqatan beyadayim, kemo sheasur lehaakilo beyadayim kol haissurin shel dibrehem kemo shennitbaer besiman shm"g:

Veken asur legadol linol et hassandal leqatan, lepi sheen zeh innuy lehaqqatan sheeno choshesh kol kak im lo yinol, abal im haqqatan noel meatzmo — im tzarik limchot beyado nitbaer besiman shm"g, ayyen sham:

Veakshav sheen nohagin lirchotz velasuk et haqqatan bekol yom, veen meniat harechitza vehassika beyom hakkippurim nechshebet lo leinnuy kelal — en lerochtzo ulesuko beyom hakkippurim. Veken hu hamminhag:

Vekol zeh beqatan shello higgia lechinnuk mitzvat innuy, abal im higgia lechinnuk — asur lehaakilo ulehashqoto ulesuko ulerochtzo beyadayim veal derek shennitbaer. Veim hu meatzmo oseh echad middebarim ellu — en tzarik limchot beyado, chutz meabiv shetztzarik limchot beyado ulechannek et beno bemitzvot, abal immo enah metzuvva al kak, abal mikkol maqom asur lah litten lepanayv leekol, dahare zeh keillu maakilato beyadayim:

Veketzad hu chinnuko? Qatan habbari ben tesha shanim shelemot (perush shennishlemu lo tesha shanim lipne yom hakkippurim), o ben eser shanim shelemot apillu hu kachush uteshush koach — mechannekin oto leshaot middibre soperim. Ketzad? Im haya ragil leekol bishte shaot al hayyom — maakilin oto beshalosh, haya ragil leekol beshalosh — maakilin oto bearba, lepi koach habben mosipin leannot oto beshaot. Veken haddin biqtanna habberia im hi bat t' shanim shelemot, o bat eser shanim shelemot apillu enah beria:

Ben y"a shanim shelemot, ben zakar uben neqeba — mitannin umashlimin middibre soperim, kede lechannekan bemitzvot. Veyesh omerim sheapillu benot y"a shanim shelemot uben zakar ben y"b shanim shelemot enan tzerikin lehashlim kelal apillu middibre soperim, ella mechannekin otan leshaot veal derek shennitbaer, dekevan shehachinnuk eno ella middibre soperim — lo ratzu chakamim lehachamir alehem kol kak sheyyitann[u] ad hallayla, veday lahem bechinnuk shaot lepi kocham. Veap al pi shehaiqqar kassebara harishona, mikkol maqom benaar shehu kachush uteshush koach veeno chazaq lisbol hattaanit — yesh lismok al sebara haacharona, umuttar lehaakilo ap sheen shum chashash sakkana im yashlim:

Ukederek shemmechannekin otan beissur akila ushetiyya hen leshaot vehen lehashlim ukemo shennitbaer — kak tzarik lechanneka[n] beissur rechitza vesika apillu middin hattalmud velo mechamat hamminhag bilbad:

Ben y"g shanim shelemot uneqeba bat y"b shelemot, im hebiu shette searot — hare hem kigdolim lekol hammitzvot vechayyabim lehashlim hattaanit min hattora, abal im adayin lo hebiu shette searot — adayin hen qetannim veen chayyabin lehashlim min hattora, abal chayyabim lehashlim middibre soperim lepi sebara harishona shebbearnu shehi iqqar. Vaapillu benaar shehu kachush vetash koach — en lehaqel lismok al sebara haacharona shebbearnu, dekevan sheaberu lo y"g shanim anu chosheshin shemma hebi kebar shette searot venasheru, lepi shedderek hu lehabi shette searot miyyad achar y"g shanim, veim ken hare yesh kan sapeq shemma hu chayyab lehashlim min hattora. Vaapillu nishlemu lo hay"g shanim beyom hakkippurim atzmo, shennolad beyom hakkippurim — ap al pi ken chayyab lehashlim, apillu hu kachush vetash koach, lepi shebbitchillat kenisat lel yom hakkippurim kebar nishlemu lo y"g shanim, veyesh lachosh shemma hebi shette searot beyom hakkippurim venasheru beyom hakkippurim, vekol sapeq shel tora holekin bo lehachamir:
Bammeh debarim amurim? Beyom hakkippurim shehu min hattora, abal bishar taaniyyot sheenan ella middibre soperim — en tzerikin lehitannot ella im ken yadua shehebiu shette searot:
Qatan shehu pachot mibben tesha shanim shelemot — en meannin oto beyom hakkippurim. Vaapillu im haqqatan rotzeh lehachamir al atzmo — mochin beyado, kede shello yabo lide sakkana:

Mah sheen medaqdeqim akshav sheyyitanneh qatan keshehu ben y"a shanim shelemot, lepi shehakkol lomedim akshav vehattora matteshet kocham ulekak enan chashubin kibriin leinyan zeh, ukebar nitbaer shekkol sheeno bari eno tzarik lehashlim lepi sheyyesh lismok al sebara haacharona shebbearnu, veod debizman hazzeh sheyyorda chulsha laolam min hassetam kol qatan eno nechshab kebari leinyan zeh, ella im ken yadua shehu bari vechazaq lisbol:
